notes.title: Major Update - v1.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
[list]
[*]New selectable character with custom cutscene
[*]Reset and checkpoint system for easy mode
[/list]

[h1]New Features[/h1]
Due to many requests, we've added a reset and checkpoint system to easy mode. This makes the game much more accessible to new players and much easier to finish. This feature is not available in other game modes. We have also added a new playable character that comes with a new custom cutscene.

notes.title: Tutorial & User Experience Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
We have completely overhauled the tutorial section of the game and have made various quality of life improvements to improve the user experience.

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]Overhauled Tutorial
[*]UI improvements
[*]Faster fading animation
[/list]

notes.title: Tutorial Improvements
notes.content:

This update improves the text in the tutorial section of Level 1 and adds additional tutorial text in Level 2 in order to improve reading clarity.

[h1]Update Details[/h1]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved tutorial text for slam jump and camera movement for clarity
[*]Added tutorial text in Level 2 for gear interaction
[/list]
